text:
oliver: Heads-up 12:30 delivery for a celebration cake and a small prop box. Courier says curbside drop at 12:15. Can front desk accept and fridge it? Also need a temp badge for vendor who will set up at 12:45. cc @frontdesk :cake:
frontdesk: We can accept cake but note fridge space limited. Please label with owner and 'perishable'. For temp badge we need full name and company. If courier is curbside ask them to ring bell and we'll meet them.
aisha: I can clear a fridge shelf by 12:00. Also please avoid dairy-free mixes? Ron is lactose intolerant so mark any dairy items.
ron: thanks! If it's nut-free I'm safe but please ping if unsure.
people-ops-bot: Temp badge request pending. Please provide vendor name to generate badge. Reminder: large deliveries may be routed to Mailroom A if courier insists on drop-off after 13:00.
claire: Vendor is 'SweetThings Co' 12:45 onsite; contact Claire 555-0123. I'll DM frontdesk the attendee name.
frontdesk: Got the name, temp badge created: BADGE-420 (valid 05/05 09:00-17:00). We'll hold cake at desk fridge and will call Claire when it's here. Please pick up by 13:30 or we'll move to staging.
oliver: Perfect. Anyone want a slice? Reply with "cake" and I'll put you on the pickup list.
aisha: cake
ron: not me, thanks
claire: cake
frontdesk: All set. If fridge fills up, we'll chill the cake in the staging fridge and label it. Also reminder to label slices clearly if sharing (name + date).
